Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent 6-portrait game sprite atlas for Dewhaven, a premium cozy fantasy farming RPG. Create a landscape 1536 x 1024 atlas, a mathematically regular 3-column by 2-row grid of equal 512-square cells. Each cell contains one separate charming hand-painted waist-up character portrait, centered in its cell with generous transparent empty margin on all sides, never touching another cell. Soft detailed gouache, warm storybook lighting, elegant confident silhouettes, crisp clean cutout edges, cohesive collectible RPG illustration. Use the supplied sprite sheet only as a clothing and hair color reference; do not copy its eye/nose features or its pixel medium. Portraits have visible lighted skin-colored faces, gently shaped cheek/chin outline, but ABSOLUTELY NO EYES, NO NOSE, NO NOSTRILS, NO EYEBROWS, NO MOUTH, NO FACIAL FEATURES, no black face, no face mask or dark shadow. Entire faces are softly illuminated smooth featureless skin, no implied eye marks or nose contour. Personality comes from hairstyle, clothes, hands and pose. Natural human adults with cozy fantasy styling. No text, letters, labels, frames, circles, borders, panels, backgrounds, scenery, watermark or drop shadows. True transparent alpha background. Keep the six complete busts separate, no overlap, hair and shoulders fully inside their own square. Cell order left to right top row, then bottom row:
1. Mira: young female seedkeeper, chestnut shoulder-length hair, cream blouse, lilac work apron, small packet of seeds
2. Rowan: male woodland ranger, auburn hair beneath a russet pointed travel cap, burnt-orange cloak, practical leather strap
3. Elias: male village mayor, blue fringe, ivory hood and charcoal coat with burgundy collar, a folded civic ledger
4. Cleo: female cafe owner, navy bob, light cream blouse, sage apron, a glazed ceramic cup
5. Finn: male lake wanderer, swept teal-blue hair, turquoise scarf and canvas fishing vest
6. Orin: male smith, brown hair, a raised steel brow guard that does not cover the face, charcoal work clothes and indigo leather apron
